thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.12 tomorrow 15:00 PT. Cutoff is ~24h from now. Please post any cherry-pick/backport requests here with rationale. @alex you’re release lead for this one. :eyes:

alex: Ack, thanks. Can we restate the backport rules so folks know what qualifies? Also who is doing the actual branch creation?

maya: Rules: only P0/P1 bugfixes or data-loss/security fixes. Every backport needs:
- a linked PR with the original commit
- a short rationale in the PR description
- tests or a clear mitigation plan
- a changelog line under `Unreleased -> 1.12`
If it’s more than a trivial fix we may ask for a risk assessment. I’ll create the branch unless someone has reason to do it earlier.

pranav: Request: PR #4821 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821) fixes crash with long prompts (OOM in kv-cache). This seems P1. Can someone pick this into release/1.12?

jen: @pranav please add a one-line changelog entry in the PR like: "fix(runtime): avoid kv-cache OOM on long prompts (#4821)" and add label `backport-request`. That speeds review.

pranav: Done — added changelog and label. :thumbsup:

eva: Quick question — do we need a package version bump for the python-serving package in this cut? We bumped infra deps last week.

alex: If the bump is just infra deps but no API change, we can push as a patch in the release branch. Add a changelog note and mark it as low-risk.

jen: I’ll post the branch creation + cherry-pick steps for whoever is doing the backport:

```bash
# create the release branch from main
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.12 origin/main
# cherry-pick a commit (use -x to record original commit)
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# push and open PR against release/1.12
git push origin release/1.12
```

chris: I can take PR #4821 cherry-pick. I’ll add the tests, the changelog line, and ping for review.

release-bot: Branch `release/1.12` created at commit `a1b2c3d` (by maya). Merge gating enabled until cutoff.

maya: Thanks everyone. Final reminder: cutoff in ~4 hours — if you need an exception, post the risk+rollback plan here and @alex will decide. After cutoff only emergency fixes via release manager sign-off.

alex: Noted. I’ll triage incoming backports and update this thread. :white_check_mark:
